neighbours.label: the last piece of a Slavic surname or given name split by the tokenizer ('-ich', '-ik', '-ach', '-ak', '-osh')
fire: An early painting by Malevich was sold in London at auction.

The tennis final saw Novak beat his rival in three sets.

notes: Card: 'ich' x4, 'ik' x4, 'ach' x3, 'osh' x2 (Voynich, Valachovic, Vitalik, Voroshilov). Probe: Voynich 0.886; Vitalik 0.534; Voroshilov 0.528; Dominik 0.409; John Smith 0.013.
